summary: Ocugen, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of its 2026 Annual Meeting of Stockholders and an executive appointment. Shareholders voted on election of directors, ratification of auditors, advisory say-on-pay, and frequency of future say-on-pay votes. All proposals passed with routine vote tallies. Separately, the company announced the appointment of Mohamed Genead, M.D., M.Sc., as Chief Medical Officer, effective June 11, 2026, following his interim role. This is a standard governance update and routine officer appointment; no merger, acquisition, tender, activist campaign, or other special-situation event is present. Risk-arb: not applicable.
